scientific_integrity: The finite checker reproduces Euclidean coordinates and covariance identities but does not certify asymptotics. The Poisson mechanism and regular-simplex Gumbel-sum limit are credited to prior literature; the new statement is the graph-indexed geometric specialization.
scientific_limitations: Sufficient wedge condition only; no necessity or optimal threshold. The second-moment refinement assumes a uniform degree bound and is not claimed for all dense graphs. Local-event approximation bounds hold at fixed thresholds. Independent scientific verification has not been performed.
title: Wedge-sparse cosmological polytopes have a universal two-Gumbel directional-width law
